e4.note: Mean over seeds. Within a seed every arm sees the same mobility, traffic, config-drift and attack sequence (common random numbers). Agent outcome and latency per configuration are replayed from E1 measurements; configurations without a measured run are left to the 24 h manual audit.

e5.note: Busy hour (19:00), 19 sites, 1500 UEs. Integrity overhead = 4-byte MAC-I per PDCP PDU plus 0.05 ms processing; IPsec = 0.1 ms per packet. Ciphering cost is not modelled.

e6.note: Remediation-scheduling environment calibrated from the twin (users per site, diurnal load, outage durations). Severity weights are a stated modelling choice. Paired evaluation on 200 identical episodes; reward gain CI by bootstrap.
